content:
maya: Heads up — noticed a cluster-autoscaler scale-down yesterday in us-east that evicted multiple GPU inference pods mid-request. Clients reported partial responses. Anyone seen this pattern?

anil: Yep saw similar on Friday. Quick wins: slow down scale-down and limit bulk deletes.

chen: Agree. Also add app-level graceful shutdown (preStop) so pods finish inflight work. Short example below.

chen: ```
lifecycle:
  preStop:
    exec:
      command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "sleep 20 && /app/graceful-shutdown"]
terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 90
```

maya: For Terraform nodepools — any labels/taints we can use so CA prefers draining other groups first? We have dedicated GPU pools + general CPU pools.

anil: Use node taints and Pod tolerations to keep inference pods on GPU pools. For CA behaviour, bump `max-empty-bulk-delete` and set `scale-down-delay-after-add`. Example Helm args we use in staging:

anil: ```yaml
extraArgs:
  scan-interval: "30s"
  scale-down-delay-after-add: "10m"
  max-empty-bulk-delete: "1"
  balance-similar-node-groups: "true"
```

maya: Nice. For Terraform-managed nodepool resource, I'm planning min=1, max=6 for GPU pools and a separate low-priority spot pool. Should we add `preemptible` tag for fallback?

chen: Spot pools are fine but mark them with label `pool-type=spot` and add a NodeAffinity/priorityClass so critical inference stays on reserved GPUs. Also add a PodDisruptionBudget:

chen: ```yaml
apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: inference-pdb
spec:
  minAvailable: 80%
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: inference
```

maya: Anything to change in Terraform module for CA rollout (helm_release)? I can add the Helm value overrides above.

anil: Add chart values override and a comment in module that these flags are tuned for GPU node churn. Also consider `--expendable-pods-priority-cutoff` so critical pods are not evicted.

infra-bot: cluster-autoscaler v1.22-helm-release deployed to staging at 2026-02-12T09:07:11Z (canary 10% nodes).

maya: I'll put together a tiny PR: (1) add preStop and terminationGracePeriodSeconds to deployment template, (2) add PDB manifest, (3) bump Helm args in helm_values.yaml for staging. Will request review. Thanks all :thumbsup:

anil: SGTM. After staging validate with a synthetic load that simulates long-running inferences.

chen: Also add a short test in our chaos harness: simulate node deletion and assert no 5xx/partial-responses.

maya: Will do, filing the PR now.
